description: Show or set how long your account keeps saved results. The default is "none": nothing is stored until you choose. Free for every account: 24h, 7d, 15d. 30d, 90d and until_deleted are part of a paid plan. With no argument, shows the current setting. A call made with _handle:true is kept for this long; it may shorten it with _retention, never lengthen it.

retention.description: New retention. Omit to read the current setting.

name: nplg-catalog__result_settings
